verdict.rationale: Salv is an AML and screening platform, so adverse-media review is a fair question for it. However, the evidence only documents sanctions-list name screening, AI match adjudication, case management and person risk factors. Nothing mentions adverse-media or negative-news screening, linked article evidence, or adverse-media risk categories. Sanctions screening is a different capability and does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can review adverse-media matches with linked evidence and risk categories
